record.field: Bank account changes always leave a trace

Detects bank details changed while hiding it, using three independent signals: the change appears on the owner's chatter but tracking on the bank account was switched off (tracking_disable via the API); the account was modified with no audit-trail entry at all; or the number no longer matches Shield's own fingerprint from the previous assessment.
Treat as a suspected fraud attempt: freeze payments to the account, verify it with the vendor on a known phone number, and review what else the same user changed through the API.
No bank account shared between unrelated contacts

Flags an account number registered on two or more different contacts. A vendor's IBAN/CBU that also sits on an employee's private contact, or on a contact an employee created, is the signature of ghost vendors and payroll or refund diversion.
Identify the real owner of the account with the bank or vendor; remove it from the contact that should not hold it and review all payments made to it.
